validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: CONFIRMED as a real dry-gas transmission line, independently and by name. The sheet's OWN cited sources do NOT support it - gem.wiki cites only two generic OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin PDFs (ASB2012 p.75; ASB2017), the same aggregate citation pasted onto every P184x/P185x Iraq row; url_verifier confirms ASB2012.pdf resolves 200 but does NOT contain 'Khor', so it never names this pipeline. Independent confirmation instead comes from: (1) Al-Sharq newspaper (alsharqpaper.com) - Oil Pipelines Company maintenance notice explicitly describing 'the dry-gas pipeline extending from Khor Al-Zubair to Al-Hartha power station' (أنبوب الغاز الجاف الممتد من خور الزبير إلى محطة توليد كهرباء الهارثة), matching GEM's endpoints exactly, operator = Oil Pipelines Company; (2) Kurdistan24 - a 'main gas pipe' feeding the Al-Hartha power station (Aug 2019 explosion cutting power); (3) TRAC/trackingterrorism - a gas pipeline serving Khor Al-Zubair station (May 2023 explosion); (4) Basrah Gas Company - dry gas from the KAZ-NGL plant (~30 km south of Basra) is delivered to South Gas Company for distribution to Basra power plants incl. Al-Hartha. CLASSIFICATION: correct - a gas (dry-gas) transmission trunk feeding power stations, not oil/NGL and not a gathering/plant-internal line; none of the GulfPub Iraq oil lines match it. DUPLICATE: none - distinct from P7435 (Khor Al-Zubair docks->Shatt Al-Arab regulator, 42 in / 40 km / 200 mcm-d, a separate 2025 project), P2234 (Rumaila->KAZ, 42 in), P6824 (Shouibah->KAZ), and P7474 (Najibiya PS). ATTRIBUTION: FuelSource 'Khor Al Zubair' consistent with the dry-gas source; owner 'Iraq Ministry of Oil' acceptable at parent level (operator more precisely = Oil Pipelines Company, an MoO state company); StartLocation is blank in the sheet and should be 'Khor Al-Zubair'. SPEC: Diameter 24 in is corroborated by Al-Sharq ('24 عقدة' scraper system on the Hartha-feeding dry-gas line) but the SAME article calls the damaged section '20 عقدة' (20 in) - a real 20/24 ambiguity, so diameter is medium not high. Length 77 km and Capacity 4.80 bcm/y have NO independent source naming this line (straight-line KAZ->Hartha is ~55-60 km, so 77 km routed is plausible but unverified; 4.80 bcm/y is a plausible but uncited figure) - these trace only to the generic OPEC ASB / GEM estimate and remain UNRESOLVED. Existence, classification, and endpoints are solid; the caveat is spec-only (length/capacity uncorroborated, diameter 20/24 ambiguity).

routes.corridor_desc: Entirely within Basra Governorate. The dry-gas line runs northward from the Khor Al-Zubair gas complex/port area (KAZ-NGL, ~30 km south of Basra city per Basrah Gas Company; approx 30.19N,47.89E) up to the Al-Hartha thermal power station at Al-Hartha, on the west/east bank of the Shatt al-Arab north of Basra city (Al-Hartha town at 30.717N,47.717E per Wikipedia; the power station is within a few km). Endpoints are high-confidence (named facilities, confirmed by the OPC maintenance notice); the exact intervening alignment (whether it skirts west of Basra city or follows the Shatt al-Arab corridor / an existing pipeline ROW) is NOT surveyed. Straight-line ~55-60 km vs GEM's 77 km routed length, consistent with a non-direct path. Coordinates for the two endpoints are defensible from named places; the mid waypoint is an approximate 'passes by Basra city' anchor, not a surveyed point.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints established from the OPC maintenance notice (Al-Sharq), which names the line as running from Khor Al-Zubair to the Al-Hartha power station; Al-Hartha coordinate from Wikipedia (30.7167N,47.7167E); Khor Al-Zubair coordinate is the town/industrial area (~30.19N,47.89E), Basrah Gas Company places the KAZ-NGL dry-gas plant ~30 km south of Basra. No coordinates invented - the exact power-station point and the mid-corridor are approximate and labeled as such. Suggest keeping RouteAccuracy 'low' until a surveyed alignment is sourced; endpoints themselves are reliable enough that a routes-repo branch could draw a defensible two-endpoint corridor.

summary: P1850 Khor Al-Zubair-Hartha real dry-gas transmission line (OPC/MoO), endpoints+classification confirmed by independent Arabic + Kurdish sources; caveat: length 77km and capacity 4.80 bcm/y uncorroborated, diameter 20/24-in ambiguity.
